d: Delegations from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Türkiye are set to visit Tehran for talks amid an ongoing regional crisis. Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman Al Saud, Pakistani military chief Asim Munir and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin are expected to participate in a joint meeting on Monday. Iran’s delegation will be led by Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei.
